intro: Detail-oriented house painting in Franklin from a local, licensed painter. Jared Cook and his in-house crew handle the prep, the paint and the final walkthrough.
servicesIntro: One room or the whole property.

services.name: Interior Painting
services.text: Walls, ceilings, trim and baseboards, plus accent walls, wall and ceiling repair and wallpaper removal.

services.name: Exterior Painting
services.text: Full home repaints, windows, trim, accents, soffit and fascia.

services.name: Cabinet Painting
services.text: Kitchen, bathroom, linen and entryway cabinets, with surface prep, hardware removal and multiple coats.

services.name: Deck Staining
services.text: Pressure washing, staining and railing painting to protect your deck and update its look.

services.name: Commercial Painting
services.text: Retail, office, medical and storefront painting for local businesses.

why.name: In-house crew only
why.text: Every painter on your job is a trained New Direction employee, not a subcontractor.

why.name: Two-coat finish
why.text: Jared stands by a two-coat policy, so walls look right and last.

why.name: Final walkthrough
why.text: Before the crew leaves, you walk the finished work with them. Anything that needs attention gets handled on the spot.

steps.name: Free estimate
steps.text: Tell us about the job. We look it over and give you a quote.

steps.name: We do the work
steps.text: The crew arrives on schedule, and you get daily updates your way.

steps.name: Final look
steps.text: We finish every detail so you are satisfied with the result.
